o.norm: a bit of a back door in!
checks expected order, and the + indicates that element had a next sibling at time of emission

i.norm:
Appends a compact, human-readable signature of {@code el} to {@code log}, so that the order and shape of the streamed elements can be asserted as a single string. The signature is: 
tagName[#id][[ownText]][+];
where the optional {@code #id} and {@code [ownText]} parts are only added when present, and the trailing {@code +} marks that the element already had a next sibling when it was emitted.
Elements are emitted in document order as each one is closed, so children appear before their parents. A trailing "+" indicates the element already had a next sibling when emitted.
